from: The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate
incident_time: 12:49 2018 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 21 - 24 June 2018 Technical Delegate's Report This morning team personnel of the Scuderia Ferrari team, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the eight hour period which commenced at 02:00 on 23 June, eleven hours before the scheduled start time of P3 and ends three hours before the scheduled start time of P3 at 10:00 on 23 June. This was the first of the two individual exceptions permitted for the Scuderia Ferrari team during the 2018 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate Jo Bauer
